title: ChecksFinishedPayload

terminalId.description: The terminal the check runs in, which the environment opened and terminals.subscribe streams while it is open.

command.description: A Workspace check's shell text, kept and run verbatim through the environment's one-off shell (/bin/sh -c on POSIX) in the Workspace directory; at most 16,384 characters, and not white space alone.

anyOf.description: A run's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when the run starts or is adopted.

sourceRunId.description: The run whose edits set the check off; null for a manual check.

offerFailure.description: Whether this failure may be offered for an explicit send; false for passes, stale commands and identical failures already offered in this directory. Missing on older events.

output.description: The check's terminal output, scrubbed of registered values: its last 64 KiB (UTF-8) when more came.

truncated.description: Whether earlier output was dropped to keep the last 64 KiB.

exitCode.description: The command's exit code; null when it timed out or failed without exiting.

signal.description: The signal that ended the command, when one did; null otherwise.

timedOut.description: Whether the check ran past its 120 seconds and its terminal was closed.

anyOf.description: Why a check ended without its command's exit: launch_failed (the command could not start in its terminal), closed (its terminal was closed, or its session deleted, before the command exited) or interrupted (the environment stopped while it ran; the command is not run again).

failure.description: Why the check ended without its command's exit; null when the command exited or timed out.

description: checks.finished: how a Workspace check ended: its retained output and whether it was cut, the exit code and signal, whether it timed out, and why it failed without an exit. It passed only on exit code 0 with no signal, no timeout and no failure.
